Name: Peachy's Clint Aesthetic Mod
Author: bitterpeaches
Description:
I don't particularly like vanilla Clint, so I wanted to make him a bit cuter. 

Aesthetic updates include changing Clint's hair color to blonde, changing the goatee into a full beard, and some clothing recolors. Eventually, I would love to add seasonal outfits, but that is for a later version. This is my first mod, so I'd appreciate feedback and reports if there are any bugs.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
